text:
maria_ops: Heads up — we've seen a slow recurring pattern of GPU ECC "drift" on goliath-rack05 over the last 36h. 3 nodes showed rising corrected ECC counts then sudden job evictions. :warning:

sam_infra: confirmed. noticed increased Xid 31 spikes and occasional kernel oops in dmesg on rack05 nodes. low severity initially but frequency increased during peak batches.

lee_hw: can you paste the last nvidia-smi output from one of the noisy boxes? wondering if temperature/power cycle correlates.

maria_ops: dropping one now (goliath-05-13). log snippet below — corrected ECC increments then a driver reset: ```
Timestamp: 2026-03-17T02:14:32Z
GPU 0: corrected_ecc: 842 -> 901
[  123.456789] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, Ch 00000020, pfffffff 00000000
[  123.460000] nvidia: GPU has fallen off the bus: GPU ID 0000:65:00
```

tash_oncall: I just cordoned goliath-05-13 and drained running jobs. will reprovision to spare if RMA needed.

sam_infra: thanks. putting the rest of the rack under watchlist rule: high-corrected-ecc -> alert at 50/hr, autocreate incident if any node crosses 200/hr. also adding prefix cache flush rule to reduce long-lived KV hits (might reduce sustained load).

maria_ops: noted. asking hw team for serial batch mapping — suspect one manufacturing batch of SXM cards from vendor B had looser solder joints.

lee_hw: vendor responded: they see intermittent ECC growth in their telemetry for that lot, scheduling a field engineer next week. recommends thermal cycling test and power rail check before RMA.

maria_ops: good. can we run quick thermal throttling pass and baseline latency before field visit? schedule in next maintenance window.

sam_infra: created a short data export job to pull ECC deltas and OS event logs for the past 7 days. export path: s3://redwood-ops/goliath/rack05/ecc-drift/1873456789/

deploy-bot: kernel-hotfix v2.3.1 rolled to infra nodes at 1873457000 — no rollbacks triggered. Filtering driver debug logs enabled on cordoned nodes.

tash_oncall: after drain I redeployed the drained instances onto spare pool. performance looks normal on spares.

maria_ops: next steps: (1) finish data export + diff, (2) field engineer on site for thermal/power checks, (3) RMA candidate list if HW fails thermal stress. also add daily smoke tests on rack05 until resolved.

sam_infra: agree. I'll also lower the alert noise threshold for a week and enable automated per-card telemetry sampling at 1m.

lee_hw: FYI got one more odd log from goliath-05-07: ```
[   78.901234] nvlink: fabric err: FATAL LINK RESET on link 2
[   78.901500] nvidia: detected ECC context corruption, correcting
```

maria_ops: thanks. tagging this for a concise postmortem once we validate RMA outcomes — would like a short RCA focusing on batch correlation, thermal profile, and vendor lot. cc @product if there is customer-facing risk. :eyes:

tash_oncall: leaving the thread, will update incident ticket INC-2026-2118 with timeline.

sam_infra: adding runbook note: when corrected ECC counts grow >100/hr and Xid 31 appears, cordon+drain then enable driver debug + collect dmesg, nv-smi, nvlink stats, and hwmon temps.

maria_ops: thanks all — I'll assemble the artifacts and kick off RCA doc.
